objective: Remove the canonical adapter cycle tax while preserving identical eight-bank SRAM ports and the shared single Acc24 service state.

mechanisms.response_cutthrough: forward the completed atomic bundle on the edge its final legal bank responses arrive
mechanisms.stall_safety: accepted bank payload is captured in slot storage and a selected slot is held whenever the core stalls
mechanisms.loop_free_slot_bypass: request payload legality is independent of slot availability; a retiring slot may be reused on the same edge without feeding protocol_error
mechanisms.reuse_hazard_guard: final bank beats of a consumed cutthrough response cannot overwrite a same-edge replacement slot

same_resource_boundary.candidate_state: one shared M218 Acc24 service plus M490 adapter

decision.physical_gate: K8 throughput_per_area wins iff total logic area including M490 is below K1x8 area; energy is measured per completed identical work

next_gate: Run exact-SHA VCS and independent hammer, then matched 3.0 ns TSMC28 DC for M491 and M349 after the active M479 DC job finishes.
